task: Prevent draft/private event tickets from leaking through public ticket endpoints while preserving producer management
evidence: Public GET /ticket, /ticket/show/{id}, and /ticket/event/{eventId} currently query Ticket/Event without Event::publiclyVisible(), exposing ticket inventory/pricing for draft or private events.
Producer ticket creation is owned by a separate launch agent only at the frontend; this API hardening is independent and preserves authenticated event-owner/admin management access.
